# Enova Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results


October 22, 2026


Enova International, a leading financial services company powered by machine learning and world-class analytics, today announced financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026.


“We’re pleased to deliver another quarter of strong financial results, driven by healthy demand and stable credit, as consolidated originations, receivables, revenue and adjusted EPS all grew 25% or more year-over-year,” said Steve Cunningham, Enova’s CEO. “We’ve built a high growth, highly profitable and resilient business at Enova serving large, fragmented markets with diversified products powered by our online-only business model, world-class technology and risk management, talented team and competitive funding capabilities. Our future is bright, and our focused growth strategy has us well positioned to continue delivering on our commitment to driving long-term shareholder value while meeting our mission of helping hardworking people get access to fast, trustworthy credit.”


Read the full press release[here](https://ir.enova.com/2026-10-22-Enova-Reports-Third-Quarter-2026-Results) .
